SCENE 05 — Back at the hearth, understanding the difference — edit5.200s (20.600–25.800s)
Setting: The same small ochre-plaster room seen from the opposite end of its flat slate hearth. Charcoal-gray stone fireplace is now on the LEFT, with the same dark firebox and three short stacked logs. Sol stands to its RIGHT on the hearth apron. Blue-gray wooden floor extends toward the camera. Cool window illumination now comes from off-screen right because the view has reversed; restrained warm light comes from the fireplace at left. No new furnishings, accessories or characters.
Framing: Reverse-angle medium full-body shot from the opposite end of the hearth, at Sol's face height with a slight downward angle. Sol is now foreground SCREEN-RIGHT at x=66%, height46%, feet y=77%; the recognizable stone fireplace is background SCREEN-LEFT at x=25%, with its low wood flame at y=55%. Both entire stubby feet and the full flame tip fit. Fixed camera; quiet lower fifth for captions. This is a clear change of viewpoint after the cutaway.
First frame: Sol stands on the same flat slate hearth apron in shallow three-quarter view toward screen-left, looking at the fireplace, with both original navy eyes visible and both short arms lowered at his flanks. Keep the cream inner flame broad, original short limbs and compact proportions. He is on the RIGHT of the picture, larger than in the opening; the same gray stone fireplace and three-log fire appear on the LEFT. No overlap between Sol and the actual wood flame.
Action: During Sol's sentence, open both short arms once into the small low understanding gesture, with gentle attached body/tip follow-through and unchanged limb lengths. By local3.6s, tilt the whole compact body and attached face slightly upward toward the fixed Narrator point above camera. Maintain that gaze, low open arms and gentle listening idle throughout Arthur's Right at4.0–4.9s and the ending. Keep feet supported; no face slide, eye squish, mouth, particles or hops. The low fire remains fixed to its logs.
Last frame: Exactly the same reverse-angle composition: Sol foreground screen-right, stone fireplace screen-left. Sol's two short arms are slightly open in one low understanding gesture. His whole compact body, flame layers and attached face share a small coherent backward/upward listening tilt toward the fixed Narrator point just above camera. Preserve tall close-spaced solid navy ovals, supported feet and the broad original cream inner flame. Same three logs and low separate wood fire.
Sol: “So finding fire wasn't the same as making it.”
Narrator: “Right.”
Speaker cues: Existing05-01-sol at0.080–2.914s; original-release05-02-narrator at4.000–4.900s. Unchanged1x; preserve final picture through5.2s.
